हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Tbe9X9
show.description: Piyush lives as an ordinary tailor, hiding the truth that he is actually the owner of a massive fashion empire. He sacrifices his identity for love, but his wife Vaani values only money, luxury, and status, humiliating him at every step. As greed and betrayal slowly destroy his life, a new woman named Meher enters and recognizes his true worth. Filled with love, heartbreak, self-respect, and revenge, this story follows a man who rises after being emotionally shattered.
